title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + multi-distro support (rke2/rancher/flatcar/ubuntu) and TUF metadata updates
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped environments require vendorized offline bundles that work across multiple kube distros (rke2, Rancher-managed clusters, Flatcar, Ubuntu 22.04). This PR vendors required runtime and installer dependencies into the offline bundle, adds distro-specific manifests and startup hooks, and updates the TUF metadata generation pipeline to support incremental bundle uploads and signature rotation.

What changed (single string): Added a new multi-distro offline bundle under installer/offline-bundles/, vendorized rke2 and rancher assets, added Flatcar-compatible systemd unit templates, included Ubuntu 22.04 packaging tweaks, and updated the scripts that generate and sign TUF metadata to include distro tags and artifact versioning. Also updated Helm chart values for the private installer to expose distro-specific feature flags and preflight checks.

Testing & verification: Local airgap install tested on vSphere (rke2), Rancher-managed k8s (RKE2 upstream), Flatcar on Metal and Ubuntu 22.04 VM images; integration tests in CI run on a mocked airgap environment. Performed manual upgrade from previous offline bundle (2025.11) and validated rollback via installer --rollback.

Upgrade notes: New bundles are backwards-compatible; customers using custom images should consult the release notes for image tag mappings. No breaking API changes to installer control plane.

Checklist: [x] vendorized artifacts included, [x] TUF metadata updated and signed, [x] CI integration run, [x] reviewers approved, [x] changelog/release notes added.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we limit the size of the default bundle by excluding debug symbols? Suggest adding a VIP option to include debug artifacts.
Ava Martinez: Dropped debug symbols from default bundle and added an optional '--include-debug' flag to installer/bin/install.sh. Updated docs with the flag usage.
Priya Desai: Integration smoke test flakes occasionally on first CI run (network timeout when pulling local registry). Please add retry/backoff to the registry bootstrap step.
Ava Martinez: Added a retry loop with exponential backoff to the registry bootstrap in tests and pushed the fix. Re-ran CI and integration job passed.
Noah Kim: TUF metadata generation looks good; ensure key rotation path is documented for customers with HSM-backed keys.
Ava Martinez: Added key rotation section to docs/onprem/airgap-offline-bundles.md and included example KMS/HSM rotation commands.
ci_checks: integration-airgap: pass (rerun after fixing flaky registry bootstrap)
security-scan: pass (no high severity findings in vendored artifacts)
release_notes: Add multi-distro offline bundle: vendorized rke2/rancher/flatcar/ubuntu artifacts, updated TUF metadata generator (supports distro tags and incremental manifests), installer improvements (preflight checks, optional debug artifact flag), and documented upgrade/rollback guidance. No breaking changes to installer API. Customers with custom images should review image tag mappings.
testing_and_verification: Manual install/upgrade/rollback verified on rke2 (vSphere), Rancher-managed clusters, Flatcar on bare metal, and Ubuntu 22.04 VMs. CI integration provides a mocked airgap environment; added retries for registry bootstrap to reduce flakiness.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Bundle size regression may impact airgapped upload windows - Mitigation: default bundle excludes debug symbols and provides an opt-in flag for full artifacts
Risk: Distro-specific hooks may behave differently across kernel versions - Mitigation: added preflight distro/version checks and documented supported OS/kernel matrix
Risk: TUF signing key rotation complexity - Mitigation: documented rotation steps and provided example scripts for KMS/HSM users
notes: This PR consolidates several vendorization efforts and unblocks customers migrating from older offline bundles. Follow-up tasks: automated bundle delta generation, add flatcar-specific e2e scenario in CI, and telemetry to track install success rates in offline installs.
